subject: Satellite model entry exemption & ingress dependency triage
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Satellite model entry exemption & ingress dependency triage

Team — looping you on a time-sensitive request from Nebula Health (EMR vendor) as we move to finalize their POC: they want to pin to the Satellite-3 large variant for 90 days due to internal validation and regulatory audit timing.

Quick background: Nebula has a 3-week evaluation period and will run predictable workloads (94% text-generation calls, bursts at start-of-day). They asked that we guarantee a specific variant (Satellite-3) for the duration to avoid model drift affecting clinical checks. Legal/procurement will accept a short-term pin if we can: (a) document compatibility checks, (b) provide a fallback policy, and (c) commit to an ingress routing plan that keeps latency SLAs.

Ask: can Eng/Runtime accept a provisional pin for Satellite-3 for 90 days? If yes, what are the compat checks we must complete before we tell the customer 'yes' (tokenizer parity, kv-cache format, quantization vector compatibility, and runtime ABI)? Also need a clear rollback/fallback plan if we discover a quality regression during the trial.

Attachments: provisional-pin-request.docx, satellite_integration_spec_v1.pdf, nebula_map_of_calls.csv

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite model entry exemption & ingress dependency triage

Thanks Ben — high level yes we can usually support a 90-day provisional pin but need to scope the checks. From runtime side here's the checklist I want to validate before we sign off: 

- Tokenizer parity test (round-trip, special medical tokens)
- KV cache binary layout compatibility across builds (we'll run a cross-build replay)
- FP/quantization profile (Satellite-3 has a custom 4-bit quant; confirm no unacceptable hallucination deltas)
- Latency profile at Nebula's expected seq lengths (median seq 120 tokens, 95th at 420)
- Memory & shard placement for sustained morning bursts

If Soojin can run the tokenizer/telemetry smoke and give an ETA, we'll draft a fallback: auto-failover to Satellite-2-lite with token-level similarity gating for 5 business days while we roll a hotfix. Also want to capture exportability: if Nebula exports KV caches, we need to include explicit warnings.

Sooj, can you confirm the quick smoke ETA? I can start drafting the canary/fallback runbook and update the SLA impact matrix.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite model entry exemption & ingress dependency triage

Ben / Karthik — ran the initial tokenizer parity and a 1K-sample generation sweep against Satellite-3. Summary:

- Tokenizer: minor OoV edge cases around the vendor's clinical shorthand; fixed by adding 6 special tokens (patch attached).
- KV cache: binary layout matches our current runtime; no rewrite needed.
- Quantization: 4-bit profile shows a small increase in latency (avg +8ms/token) but within their 200ms P95 bucket.
- Quality delta vs Satellite-2-lite: average BLEU/ROUGE differences are small, but there are a handful of medic-specific prompts where hallucination risk is non-trivial.

ETA for a full compatibility sign-off (including canary run in staging with Nebula sample traffic): 4 business days. I'll upload the raw telemetry to the shared drive.

Proposed immediate mitigation: allow a provisional pin with these guardrails: 
1) 4-day sign-off window (deliver tests + canary plan)
2) Canary traffic routed to a reserved pool with traffic shaping at startup (ramp 5% -> 50% over 45m)
3) Auto-fallback to Satellite-2-lite if similarity drops below 0.92 on daily evals or error rate increases >1.5x

See attached: satellite_integration_spec_v1.pdf and nebula_map_of_calls.csv (call volumes + typical seq lengths).

Soojin
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite model entry exemption & ingress dependency triage

Appreciate the fast triage. High level decision: approve a provisional pin for 90 days provided Engineering delivers the 4-day sign-off and we get Legal to accept the fallback language (Ben, drive procurement on this). Two additional asks from my side: 

- Product needs a short note on observable quality metrics we'll use (daily similarity, hallucination flagging process). Please attach the eval thresholds to the canary plan.
- Ops: ensure resource reservation doesn't block other commitments — use preemptible reservations for the ramp window and publish cost delta for the customer.

Ben — once Karthik/Soojin confirm the 4-day plan, loop Legal/Contracts and get the DocuSign provision attached. I'd like an internal exec note summarizing risk and rollback steps for the next weekly ops review.

Marissa
VP, Customer Success & GTM
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhou <emily@nebulahealth.com>, Adam Rivera <adam.rivera@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: contracts@nebulahealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite model entry exemption & ingress dependency triage

Emily — appreciate the clarity on the audit window. Internal update: Redwood can provisionally honor Satellite-3 pin for 90 days under a conditional approval. Engineering will complete a 4-business-day compatibility sign-off (tokenizer parity, KV cache sanity, quantization smoke, and a staging canary), and we will implement an automated fallback to Satellite-2-lite if quality or error metrics cross agreed thresholds.

Next steps for Nebula: please countersign the attached provisional pin addendum and provide a 48-hour sample traffic window so we can run the canary in staging. Contracts@nebulahealth.com, please confirm contact and turnaround for the DocuSign.

I'll follow up with an internal exec note and the canary runbook once Karthik/Soojin post the sign-off artifacts. Thanks team — aiming to keep this low-friction for the customer while protecting our platform SLAs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
